metric_definitions.ranked-mode-requested-calls: Count actual model response tool calls named search whose parsed arguments explicitly set mode=ranked, including subsequently rejected arguments.
metric_definitions.ranked-mode-successful-calls: Count executed ranked search tool results with ok=true and valid closed ranked_read metadata, including empty outputs.
metric_definitions.ranked-windows-returned: Sum exact observations.length across successful ranked outputs; no delivery credit implied.
metric_definitions.receipt-confirmed-ranked-observations: Count distinct native read_id values bound to actual ranked search calls in successful model request receipts; do not count archive-only, tokenizer-only or failed dispatches.
metric_definitions.exported-union-span-recall: Existing native trajectory final-step span coverage over all confirmed exported observations, after exact projection/export reconstruction; keep unmapped changed-line count separately.
metric_definitions.useful-coverage-per-10000-model-tokens: For valid scored task i with complete positive total model tokens T_i and union recall C_i, Q_i=10000*C_i/T_i. C is fraction0..1, not percentage; T includes all model input/output and finalization.
metric_definitions.ranked-mode-empty-output-calls: Successful ranked tool calls with zero returned observations.
metric_definitions.navigation-only-model-responses: Count discovery model responses having at least one tool call and every call named list_files or rank_sources. Mixed batches and edits/search/read responses do not qualify.
metric_definitions.structural-disagreements: Advertised structural schema validity differs from runtime structural validity; report semantic UTF8/byte/source checks separately.
metric_definitions.ranked-rejection-rate: Rejected calls with parsed mode ranked divided by all calls with parsed mode ranked; zero denominator is inconclusive.
metric_definitions.unclassified-search-calls: Search calls with malformed JSON, missing/invalid mode, or unresolved execution; retain each in a separate count, never infer a mode or drop the call. Missing mode is literal only when the remaining call parses and validates.
metric_definitions.all-search-invalid-rate: All rejected search calls, including malformed JSON, divided by every requested search call; report alongside ranked rejection rate.

decision: Ineligible is inconclusive. Eligible and all support conditions is descriptive support; otherwise counterevidence. Also report all-search-invalid-rate and both historical baselines. Campaign perfect quality and untouched confirmation remain separate mandatory gates.
